inputs.modified_text:
Wake up, people. They want you to believe this is just regular political noise, but look at what is really happening behind the curtain. White House border czar Tom Homan went on “The Charlie Kirk Show” on Tuesday and openly refused to rule out putting immigration enforcement at polling places, cynically asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” 

Don't fall for their scripted theater. The official narrative calls these "inconsistent answers" from the Trump administration, but that vagueness is entirely by design. It's a calculated psychological operation to test compliance and normalize state surveillance where it matters most. They are coordinating a quiet takeover under the guise of debate, pushing forward a hidden agenda while distracting everyone with manufactured feuds.
